title: Nobody wants to buy AI
topic: The mistake of selling 'AI' instead of a result
target_audience: Beginners starting an AI agency or service
audience_problem: Business owners don't care about AI, so they get no clients

beats.visual: Close-up, deadpan delivery, two-second pause feel. Jump cut.

beats.voiceover: If you're starting an AI service and getting no replies, the word 'AI' might be the problem.
beats.visual: Phone screen showing an outreach message with the word 'AI' highlighted.

beats.voiceover: Business owners don't buy technology. They buy fewer missed calls, faster quotes, or an evening off.
beats.visual: Three quick text pops: 'fewer missed calls', 'faster quotes', 'an evening off'.

beats.voiceover: So lead with the result. Mention the AI later, if at all.
beats.visual: Talking head, hand gesture moving 'result' to the front.

beats.voiceover: Not 'I build AI chatbots'. Try: 'Every enquiry to your salon gets a reply, even when you're mid-appointment.'
beats.visual: Before/after cards: 'I build AI chatbots' (crossed out) vs the salon offer.

beats.voiceover: Comment your offer and I'll suggest a rewrite.
